hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Traverse the structure level by level to gather all node values residing at the target depth.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Because an in-order level traversal on a binary search structure maintains sorted order within subtrees, collect nodes left to right.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sort or directly access the middle element of the gathered level values to determine the median.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth traversal visits each node at most once in O(n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
